answer: Each agent must lock a slashable copper-denominated reserve and enroll a hardware-rooted cipher that answers a fresh attestation challenge only from one physical module. Every epoch, validators are sampled from an ocean of incumbents that do not share recent countersigners; the bond releases only if those disjoint jurors accept the cipher response. Spawning sybils therefore costs a full reserve plus a distinct hardware module per identity, and any farm that reuses a module or concentrates jurors in one clique is slashed, so the attacker's outlay scales linearly while expected rewards collapse.
